watch.title: Michigan U.S. Senate
watch.description: Abdul El-Sayed, a Democratic former public health official, is in a competitive race against former Representative Mike Rogers, a Republican who narrowly lost his Senate bid in 2024. The contest has become a key test for progressives, who are backing El-Sayed.

watch.title: Texas U.S. Senate
watch.description: James Talarico, a state legislator, is trying to become the first Democrat in more than three decades to win a statewide election in Texas. He is facing Ken Paxton, the Republican state attorney general, in a race that is one of the most expensive American campaigns ever.

watch.title: Iowa Governor
watch.description: In a state that has been controlled by Republicans for close to a decade, a surprisingly competitive race for governor has unfolded between Rob Sand, the Democratic state auditor, and Zach Lahn, a Republican supported by the MAHA movement.

spotlight.title: Florida Governor
spotlight.description: Byron Donalds, the Republican backed by President Trump, is vying to continue the party’s dominance in the governor’s mansion. A victory would make him Florida’s first Black governor. He faces David Jolly, a former Republican congressman who became a Democrat last year. No Democrat has held the governorship in Florida since the late 1990s.

spotlight.title: Vermont Governor
spotlight.description: Gov. Phil Scott, a moderate Republican seeking a sixth term, is facing Amanda Janoo, a progressive Democrat and a political newcomer whose campaign has picked up unexpected momentum.

spotlight.title: South Carolina U.S. Senate
spotlight.description: Senator Darline Graham, the Republican appointed to fill her deceased brother Lindsey Graham’s seat, is running for a full term of her own. Dr. Annie Andrews, a Democrat and a pediatrician, is hoping Ms. Graham’s inexperience and her ties to President Trump can help her flip a seat in a state that hasn’t elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1998.
